title: Pharaoh Nesket's Pyramid
description: Beneath the pyramid of an ancient Egyptian pharaoh, an expedition follows a trail of chisel marks to a sealed treasury. As the explorers brush sand from the door, the search moves to a 5x3 grid, where matching symbols pay along 20 fixed paylines. An expanding wild can stretch to fill its entire reel, from the top row to the bottom. The free spins round takes the expedition past the threshold, with each spin in that chamber played at no extra cost.

title: Skelwick's Herring Fleet
description: Off Skelwick's coast, the herring fleet heads out before dawn, with deck lamps trained on the nets. Back on the reels, floats and coils of rope fill a five-column, three-row grid, and wins follow 25 fixed paylines. During the free spins round, the reels keep turning at no extra cost. The pick bonus takes place on deck, where you choose among sealed catch crates to uncover prizes. The game has high volatility and a maximum win of 2,500x the bet.

title: Skelwick's Herring Fleet 2
description: Off Skelwick's coast, the herring fleet is back, hauling its nets aboard as dawn breaks. The game has high volatility and a maximum win of 5,000x the bet.

title: The Velneth Index
description: The Velneth Index records gods and heroes from Greek myth. Its entries appear as portraits on six reels with four rows. The grid has 4,096 ways to win. Matching symbols count across consecutive reels from the left. They can occupy any row on each reel. Cascading reels clear the symbols in each paid combination. Symbols above the gaps drop down, and new symbols enter from the top. The resulting grid is checked again. Win multipliers scale the payouts from these checks.

title: The Velneth Index
description: Cluster pays reward groups of touching matches across the 7x7 grid, so position matters more than lining symbols up. Sticky wilds hold their positions across spins, keeping those spots in play as the symbols around them change. The free spins round gives the grid a run of spins at no extra cost. High volatility defines the game, with a maximum win of 25,000x the bet. The reels are set aboard a deep-space relay station where maintenance robots decode signals from alien spacecraft.

title: Ghosts of Vellwick
description: At Vellwick House, the ghosts knock from inside the walls, always just as the caretaker reaches for the door. The reels frame his night rounds in a 3x3 grid, with wins paid on five fixed paylines. When a sticky wild lands, it keeps its square on subsequent spins, like a handprint the caretaker can't wipe away. A round of free spins takes him back through the same rooms, where the knocking has stopped but the doors are still moving.

title: The Orvett Register
description: The Orvett Register takes its cue from the old fruit machine: cherries, bells, bars and sevens, all plainly marked. The reels sit in a three-by-three square, with five fixed paylines across them. Only matches on those lines are counted for a win. A win multiplier can increase the amount paid on a line without altering the symbols that made the match. The arrangement is much as one would expect from a fruit machine of the old school, with the extra arithmetic left to the reels.

title: Outlaws of Brackspur
description: Kick open the saloon doors in Brackspur, where cowboys and outlaws crowd the frontier bar. You spin five reels, each three symbols high, and chase matches across 25 fixed paylines. When Hold and Respin kicks in, sheriff's badges stay pinned to the reels while you spin the open spots again. Then take your pick in the saloon's bonus round: choose sealed envelopes to reveal the prizes inside. Will you go for the one tucked under the till or the one the bartender slid across the counter?

title: Ruskfen's Badgers
description: The badgers of Ruskfen are the principal figures on a 7x7 grid, where field mice and hares also appear among the symbols. Wins come from clusters of adjacent matching symbols, with no requirement for them to form a line. After each win, the winning symbols disappear and new symbols drop into their places. A multiplier can increase the value of a win during play. The game is rated low in volatility, and its maximum win is 2,500x the bet.

title: Pharaoh Zekhrat's Cartouche
description: Step into Pharaoh Zekhrat's pyramid and watch scarab seals and carved cartouches flash across your 5x3 grid. You land wins along 20 fixed paylines, with the pharaoh's own seal stamped into the stonework behind the reels. When you trigger hold and respin, special seals stay locked where they landed while the open spots spin again. Keep an eye on the progressive jackpot, which climbs as you play until someone lands it. You get medium volatility in the pharaoh's chamber and a maximum win of 5,000x the bet.

title: Qiaolun's Lunar New Year
description: Qiaolun hangs the last red lantern outside the temple just as the Lunar New Year dragon dance reaches the courtyard. The festival fills a 6x5 grid, where clusters of adjoining identical symbols pay without needing to line up. Winning clusters clear, and fresh symbols tumble into the gaps, giving the same spin another chance to form a paying cluster. Win multipliers scale up the payouts when they apply. The game has medium volatility, and the maximum win is 500x the bet.
